facts.note: States the kitchen clock is a quarter of an hour fast and kept so on purpose so nothing is late.
Lina came down at thirteen minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stayed until after the temple struck eleven.
Piano began at two minutes to eleven and stopped at eleven minutes past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
Heard the hall clock strike eleven when the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven.

added.quote: Ja. It was nearly the toast.
added.why: Places Rosa's trip upstairs at roughly the time of the toast, giving a time relation for her leaving the kitchen that the sheet does not cover.
